These policies directly impact reimbursement and compliance requirements for PT practice in the US, and you must pay close attention to adjust future practice and operational strategies.

items.title: Comparative diagnostic utility of SPECT-CT versus MRI and CT in chronic low back pain.
items.summary: In a retrospective cohort of 122 patients with chronic low back pain, SPECT-CT positivity was moderately and independently associated with Modic changes, advanced Pfirrmann grade, and vacuum disc/facet phenomena on MRI/CT, but findings were frequently discordant, suggesting SPECT-CT may complement other imaging.
items.curatedReason: SPECT-CT 与 MRI/CT 在慢性腰痛诊断中的关联度中等，但代谢和结构发现并非可互换。在疼痛管理中考虑 SPECT-CT 作为辅助工具时，请记住其临床效用（即能否识别症状水平）仍需结果验证。
items.titleZh: SPECT-CT 对比 MRI 和 CT 在慢性腰痛中的诊断效用：一项比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 122 例慢性腰痛患者的回顾性队列研究显示，SPECT-CT 阳性与 MRI/CT 上的 Modic 改变、Pfirrmann 晚期分级、椎间盘真空征和椎小关节真空征存在中度独立关联，但影像学结果常不一致，提示 SPECT-CT 可作为其他影像学检查的补充。
items.curatedReasonEn: SPECT-CT shows moderate association with MRI/CT findings in chronic low back pain, but metabolic and structural findings are not interchangeable. When considering SPECT-CT as an adjunct in pain management, remember its clinical utility—i.e., whether it identifies symptomatic levels—still requires outcome-based validation.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性单中心队列研究，且仅关注 SPECT-CT 阳性与结构性退行性病变的关联，未验证其与患者症状改善或功能预后的直接关系。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective single-center cohort study focused only on the association between SPECT-CT positivity and structural degenerative findings, without validating its direct relationship with patient symptom improvement or functional prognosis.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Physical and psychosocial outcomes in children with limb loss 2-years after the 2023 Kahramanmaras-Türkiye earthquakes
items.summary: A retrospective analysis of children (mean 13.7 years) with earthquake-related limb loss 2.3 years post-amputation showed favorable child-reported PedsQL scores (median 72.3/100.0) for physical, social, and school domains, but lower emotional functioning (60.0/100.0), indicating the importance of long-term mental health support.
items.curatedReason: 在土耳其地震后两年，肢体缺失儿童的躯体、社交和学业相关生活质量良好，但情绪健康仍受影响。在长期康复管理中，你必须将心理健康支持与假肢适配和康复服务并重。
items.titleZh: 2023 年卡赫拉曼马拉什-土耳其地震后两年肢体缺失儿童的躯体和心理社会结局
items.summaryZh: 一项对地震相关肢体缺失儿童（平均年龄 13.7 岁）在截肢后 2.3 年的回顾性分析显示，儿童报告的 PedsQL 身体、社交和学业领域评分良好（中位数 72.3/100.0），但情绪功能较低（60.0/100.0），这凸显了长期心理健康支持的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Two years after the Turkey earthquakes, children with limb loss show favorable physical, social, and school-related quality of life, but emotional well-being remains affected. In long-term rehabilitation management, you must prioritize mental health support alongside prosthetic fitting and rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性分析，缺乏对照组，且数据来自单一中心，可能存在选择偏倚和结果的外推性限制。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective analysis lacks a control group and data are from a single center, potentially introducing selection bias and limiting the generalizability of results.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Fake nurse given good behaviour bond following Ahpra prosecution
items.summary: A Queensland woman was placed on a $2500 good behaviour bond and ordered to pay $1750 in legal costs by Ahpra for falsely claiming to be a registered nurse while employed as an Assistant in Nursing and in a teacher aide application, highlighting the regulator's strong stance against misrepresentation of professional qualifications.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚一名女子因谎称注册护士而被判守行保释，这再次提醒你，医疗执业者必须如实反映其资历和注册状态。在澳大利亚执业的物理治疗师应意识到 AHPRA 对虚假陈述注册情况的零容忍立场，以避免类似的法律后果。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局：假冒护士被判守行保释
items.summaryZh: 一名昆士兰女子因在担任助理护士期间和申请教师助理职位时谎称自己是注册护士，被澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（Ahpra）判处 2500 澳元守行保释，并需支付 1750 澳元法律费用，这凸显了监管机构对虚报专业资质的严厉立场。
items.curatedReasonEn: An Australian woman received a good behavior bond for falsely claiming to be a registered nurse, serving as a reminder that healthcare practitioners must truthfully represent their qualifications and registration status. Physical therapists practicing in Australia should be aware of AHPRA's zero-tolerance stance on misrepresenting registration to avoid similar legal consequences.

items.title: The effect of multi-joint lower-limb training on lower-limb function after total knee arthroplasty: a randomised controlled clinical trial
items.summary: A single-center RCT (n=128) found that integrating hip-ankle training into conventional rehabilitation modestly improved Lower Extremity Functional Scale (LEFS) scores at postoperative week 4 (difference +1.55 points, 95% CI 0.02-3.07, P=0.047) after TKA, and TUGT scores at weeks 8 and 12, but without significant differences in 6MWT, pain, or ROM.
items.curatedReason: 膝关节置换术（TKA）后，将髋踝训练整合到常规康复中，在早期（术后 4 周）可适度改善下肢功能，并在术后 8-12 周改善活动能力（TUGT）。在常规康复方案中，可以考虑在患者接受度高的情况下增加多关节训练，以期获得这些中期功能益处。
items.titleZh: 多关节下肢训练对全膝关节置换术后下肢功能的影响：一项随机对照临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心随机对照试验（n=128）发现，将髋踝训练整合到常规康复中，可适度改善全膝关节置换术（TKA）后下肢功能量表（LEFS）得分（术后 4 周，差异 +1.55 分，95% CI 0.02-3.07，P=0.047），并在第 8 和 12 周改善 TUGT 分数，但在 6MWT、疼痛或关节活动度方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: After total knee arthroplasty (TKA), integrating hip-ankle training into conventional rehabilitation modestly improves early lower-limb function (at 4 weeks post-op) and mobility (TUGT) at 8-12 weeks. You may consider adding multi-joint training to conventional rehabilitation when patient acceptance is high, aiming for these mid-term functional benefits.
items.limitation: 尽管早期 LEFS 有统计学差异，但临床意义阈值未达到，且优势在术后 12 周已不明显；研究主要关注短期结果，缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: Although early LEFS showed statistical significance, it did not meet the clinically important threshold, and the advantage was not evident by week 12. The study primarily focused on short-term outcomes, lacking long-term follow-up data.

items.title:
XR serious games for phantom limb pain, neurofunctional recovery, and prosthetic adoption: a systematic review
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A systematic review of 24 studies found XR serious games to show preliminary benefit in reducing phantom limb pain (AR-based systems with d = 0.9–1.3), improving functional mobility (VR exergames in 2 RCTs), and supporting prosthesis control and embodiment after amputation, with mechanistic evidence for cortical adaptation.
items.curatedReason: XR 严肃游戏在减轻幻肢痛、改善功能移动性、支持假肢控制和增强截肢后本体感方面显示出初步益处。在康复实践中，你可将其视为现有疗法的有效补充，特别是在处理幻肢痛和促进皮层适应性方面，但仍需关注其在现实世界的应用和可扩展性。
items.titleZh: XR 严肃游戏对幻肢痛、神经功能恢复和假肢采纳的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 24 项研究的系统综述发现，XR 严肃游戏在减轻幻肢痛（基于 AR 的系统效应量 d = 0.9–1.3）、改善功能移动性（2 项 RCT 中的 VR 运动游戏），以及支持截肢后假肢控制和本体感方面显示出初步益处，并提供了皮层适应的机制性证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: XR serious games show preliminary benefits in reducing phantom limb pain, improving functional mobility, supporting prosthesis control, and enhancing embodiment after amputation. In rehabilitation practice, you may consider them an effective adjunct to existing therapies, especially for phantom limb pain and cortical adaptation, while noting the need for further research on real-world implementation and scalability.
items.limitation: 尽管 XR 游戏效果显著，但证据主要来自小型研究和探索性发现，缺乏大规模、高质量的 RCT，且在现实世界中的实施和可扩展性仍需更多研究。
items.limitationEn: Despite significant effects, evidence for XR games is mainly from small studies and exploratory findings, lacking large-scale, high-quality RCTs, and further research is needed on real-world implementation and scalability.

items.title: Aqua Steps: A Feasibility Study of a new Aquatic Exercise Therapy Intervention for Falls Prevention in Older Adults.
items.summary: A feasibility study of a new aquatic exercise intervention (Aqua Steps) with 101 older adults at high falls risk found high feasibility and acceptability. It reduced falls by 38%, fallers by 36%, and frequent fallers by 58%, with significant improvements in functional (22%-70%) and strength (10%-80%) tests.
items.curatedReason: Aqua Steps 水中运动干预对高跌倒风险老年人的跌倒预防显示出高可行性和初步积极效果。作为一种安全且受欢迎的替代方案，你可以将其作为陆上运动的补充或替代选择，特别是在平衡和力量训练方面具有潜在优势。
items.titleZh: Aqua Steps：一项针对高跌倒风险老年人跌倒预防的新型水中运动疗法干预的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 101 名高跌倒风险老年人的新型水中运动干预（Aqua Steps）可行性研究显示，该方案可行性高、接受度好，并使跌倒发生率降低 38%，跌倒者减少 36%，频繁跌倒者减少 58%，功能（22%-70%）和力量（10%-80%）测试均有显著改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Aqua Steps aquatic exercise intervention shows high feasibility and promising preliminary effects for falls prevention in older adults at high risk. As a safe and popular alternative, you can consider it as a complementary or alternative option to land-based exercises, especially for its potential benefits in balance and strength training.
items.limitation: 本研究为可行性研究，虽然显示出初步积极效果，但样本量有限（101 名老年人），未进行随机对照，需要大规模 RCT 来确证其在跌倒预防中的长期有效性。
items.limitationEn: This feasibility study, while showing promising preliminary effects, had a limited sample size (101 older adults) and was not a randomized controlled trial. A large-scale RCT is needed to confirm its long-term effectiveness in falls prevention.

items.title: Who am I now? Experienced changes of occupational identity after spinal cord injury.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study with six adults explored the dynamic process of redeveloping occupational identity after spinal cord injury, revealing uncertainty and transformation influenced by daily activities and environmental contexts.
items.curatedReason: 对脊髓损伤患者来说，职业认同的重建是康复的关键一环。这项小样本定性研究提示，支持患者探索新的自我价值和人生叙事，能帮助他们更好地应对身份转变，尤其要关注日常活动和环境对其职业认同的影响。
items.titleZh: 我是谁？脊髓损伤后职业认同变化的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 6 名脊髓损伤成人进行的定性访谈研究发现，患者在重建职业认同过程中经历了不确定性和动态转变，受日常活动和环境因素影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Redeveloping occupational identity is crucial for individuals with spinal cord injury. This small qualitative study suggests that supporting patients in exploring new self-worth and life narratives can help them navigate identity transformation, with particular attention to how daily activities and environmental contexts influence their occupational identity.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（6 名成人），结果主要为探索性发现，不具备普适性。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study with a small sample size (six adults) provides exploratory findings that are not generalizable.

items.title: Does Hemiplegic Side Matter? A Cross-Sectional Study of Laterality Impacts on Mobility, Balance, Hand Dexterity, and Cognition in Stroke Patients.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 51 first-ever stroke patients found that left hemiplegic patients showed reduced functional mobility, poorer postural control, increased fall risk, and reduced impaired hand dexterity compared to right hemiplegic patients, while exhibiting higher cognitive scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明卒中偏瘫侧对患者的活动能力、平衡、手部灵巧性和认知有显著影响。在制定康复策略时，你应针对患者的偏瘫侧特异性缺陷进行定制化干预。
items.titleZh: 偏瘫侧有影响吗？一项横断面研究探讨卒中患者偏瘫侧对活动能力、平衡、手部灵巧性和认知的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 51 名首次卒中患者的横断面研究发现，左侧偏瘫患者的功能活动能力、姿势控制和跌倒风险较右侧偏瘫患者差，受损手灵巧性降低但认知得分更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that the hemiplegic side in stroke patients significantly impacts mobility, balance, hand dexterity, and cognition. When developing rehabilitation strategies, you should tailor interventions to side-specific deficits.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面研究，样本量为 51 名首次卒中患者，且仅在短期内观察，结果尚不能推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study with 51 first-ever stroke patients was observed only for a short period, and its results cannot infer causality.

items.title: Interactive Gardening Intervention for Preschoolers With Developmental Delays: A Family-Centered Feasibility Study.
items.summary: A non-randomized controlled pilot study (60 caregiver-child dyads) found a 6-week family-centered gardening intervention feasible and well-accepted for preschoolers with developmental delays, improving social functioning (mean change, 3.34; p = .007) but not sensory integration or caregiver outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性研究提示，以家庭为中心的互动式园艺干预可作为支持发育迟缓学龄前儿童社会参与的补充方法。虽然对感觉统合和照护者相关结局无显著影响，但其可行性和可接受性高，并改善了儿童的社会功能，值得你在早期干预中考虑。
items.titleZh: 互动式园艺干预对发育迟缓学龄前儿童的影响：一项以家庭为中心的可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 60 对亲子进行的非随机对照预试验发现，为期 6 周的家庭中心园艺干预对发育迟缓学龄前儿童可行且接受度高，改善了社会功能（平均变化 3.34；p = .007），但对感觉统合和照护者结局无显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility study suggests that an interactive, family-centered gardening intervention can serve as a complementary approach to support social participation in preschoolers with developmental delays. While showing no significant impact on sensory integration or caregiver-related outcomes, its high feasibility and acceptability, coupled with improved child social functioning, warrant consideration in early intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为非随机对照预试验，样本量有限（60 对亲子），随访期短（6 周），对感觉统合和照护者结局无显著改善，需要更大规模的 RCT 来确证其长期效果。
items.limitationEn: This non-randomized controlled pilot study has a limited sample size (60 caregiver-child dyads) and a short follow-up period (6 weeks), showing no significant improvements in sensory integration or caregiver outcomes. Larger RCTs are needed to confirm long-term effects.

items.title: Power of Functional Mobility Tests in Predicting Fall Risk Among Older Adults.
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort study (n=41 participants classified as fallers and 122 non-fallers) found Timed Up and Go Test (TUG, AUC=0.777) and Four Square Step Test (FSST, AUC=0.771) had the highest discrimination for predicting falls in older adults, but no single test was sufficient. Combining tests with fall history significantly improved model fit (bootstrap-corrected AUC 0.89-0.97).
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究提示，在社区老年人跌倒风险评估中，TUG 和 FSST 具有最佳的预测判别力，但单一测试不足以可靠预测未来跌倒。将这些功能测试与跌倒史结合，能显著提高预测模型的准确性，你应在临床实践中综合运用。
items.titleZh: 功能活动度测试在预测老年人跌倒风险中的效力
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名跌倒者和 122 名非跌倒者进行的前瞻性观察性队列研究发现，TUG（AUC=0.777）和 FSST（AUC=0.771）在预测跌倒风险方面判别力最高，但单一测试不足。将测试与跌倒史结合可显著改善模型拟合（bootstrap 校正 AUC 0.89-0.97）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that TUG and FSST offer the best predictive discrimination for fall risk in community-dwelling older adults, though no single test is sufficiently reliable. Combining these functional tests with fall history significantly improves prediction model accuracy, so you should use them in combination in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，包括 41 名跌倒者和 122 名非跌倒者，并且其模型改善结果是探索性的，需要外部验证才能推及更广泛人群。
items.limitationEn: This observational study of 41 participants classified as fallers and 122 non-fallers had exploratory model improvement results that require external validation for broader applicability.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Injury risk and physical therapy utilization following knee surgery in U.S. Army soldiers: a comparison of military and non-military treatment facilities.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 4924 U.S. Army soldiers found that those undergoing knee surgery at non-military treatment facilities (32% of cohort) had higher subsequent injury rates (79% vs. 73%) and longer physical therapy duration (8.3 vs. 7.1 weeks; p = 0.038) compared to those treated at military facilities.
items.curatedReason: 美军士兵膝关节手术后若在非军事医疗机构就医，再受伤风险更高，物理治疗时长也更长。这提示 PT 执业者评估患者预后时要考虑其治疗环境。
items.titleZh: 美军士兵膝关节手术后受伤风险与物理治疗利用率：军事与非军事医疗机构的比较
items.summaryZh: 一项对 4924 名美军士兵的回顾性队列研究显示，在非军事医疗机构接受膝关节手术的士兵（占队列的 32%）再受伤率更高（79% vs. 73%），物理治疗持续时间也更长（8.3 vs. 7.1 周；p = 0.038）。
items.curatedReasonEn: U.S. Army soldiers receiving knee surgery at non-military treatment facilities face higher re-injury risk and longer PT duration. This suggests PTs should consider treatment setting when assessing patient prognosis.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study, limiting causal inference and potentially subject to unmeasured confounders.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Comparison of robot-assisted gait training and visual feedback balance training on balance and gait outcomes in patients with stroke: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=50) in stroke patients found that visual feedback balance training (ProKin-252) led to a statistically greater improvement in Berg Balance Scale (adjusted difference of 1.43 points, 95% CI, 0.37-2.49; p = .009) and fear of falling compared to robot-assisted gait training (RoboGait), with both showing improvements in functional mobility and gait speed.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者的平衡和步态康复中，视觉反馈平衡训练（ProKin）在平衡能力和跌倒恐惧方面优于机器人辅助步态训练（RoboGait），但两者在步态和整体功能上差异不显著。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助步态训练与视觉反馈平衡训练对卒中患者平衡和步态结局的比较：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对卒中患者的随机对照试验（n=50）发现，与机器人辅助步态训练（RoboGait）相比，视觉反馈平衡训练（ProKin-252）在 Berg 平衡量表评分（调整后差异 1.43 分，95% CI, 0.37-2.49；p = .009）和跌倒恐惧方面有统计学上更显著的改善，两者在功能移动和步速上均有提高。
items.curatedReasonEn: For stroke patients' balance and gait rehabilitation, visual feedback balance training (ProKin) showed superiority over robot-assisted gait training (RoboGait) in balance and fear of falling, though no significant differences were found in gait or overall functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 调整后的 Berg 平衡量表分数差异（1.43 分）虽具统计学意义，但临床意义可能相对有限。
items.limitationEn: The adjusted Berg Balance Scale difference (1.43 points), while statistically significant, may have limited clinical meaningfulness.

items.title: From Referral to Reality: A Mixed Methods Analysis of Barriers to Pediatric Rehabilitation Service Initiation.
items.summary: A mixed-methods study analyzing 8,533 pediatric rehabilitation referrals found an overall service initiation rate of 42.7%. Key barriers included geographic availability, scheduling challenges, how professionals communicate service needs, prior rehabilitation experience, competing family priorities, financial/transportation issues, and a "wait and see" approach.
items.curatedReason: 儿科康复服务的启动率仅 42.7%，地理可及性、排班、费用、交通和专业人士沟通方式都是家长面临的障碍。你需要关注这些社会人口学差异，优化转诊沟通，以提高服务可及性。
items.titleZh: 从转诊到现实：儿科康复服务启动障碍的混合方法分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8,533 份儿科康复转诊的混合方法研究发现，总体服务启动率仅为 42.7%。主要障碍包括地理可及性、排班挑战、专业人士沟通服务需求的方式、既往康复经验、家庭优先事项冲突、财务/交通问题以及“观望”态度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pediatric rehabilitation service initiation rates are only 42.7%, with barriers including geographic availability, scheduling, cost, transportation, and communication by professionals. You need to address these sociodemographic disparities and optimize referral communication to improve service access.
items.limitation: 研究的定性部分样本量较小（12 位家长），可能无法完全代表所有非启动案例的复杂性。
items.limitationEn: The qualitative component had a small sample size (12 parents), which may not fully represent the complexity of all non-initiation cases.

items.title: Individualized systems-informed corrective exercise for adults meeting prespecified criteria for upper crossed syndrome: protocol for a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This is a protocol for a parallel randomized controlled trial (n=36) to examine the added effect of a structured, individualized, staged corrective-exercise program for adults with upper crossed syndrome. Both groups will receive stationary cycling, indication-based stretching, mobilization, and education, with the intervention group adding a systems-informed corrective program.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 协议将评估针对上交叉综合征的个体化、系统知情纠正性运动方案，能否在常规治疗基础上带来额外益处。如果你关注这种常见姿势问题的干预，可以留意未来结果。
items.titleZh: 针对符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人：系统知情纠正性运动的随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: 这是一项平行随机对照试验（n=36）的方案，旨在评估针对符合上交叉综合征预设标准的成年人，结构化、个体化、分阶段的纠正性运动方案所带来的额外效果。两组都将接受固定自行车、基于适应症的牵伸和松动以及健康运动习惯教育，干预组在此基础上增加系统知情纠正性方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT protocol will assess if an individualized, systems-informed corrective exercise program for upper crossed syndrome provides added benefits beyond conventional therapy. If you treat this common postural issue, keep an eye on future results.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未有实际研究结果公布。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and no actual research results have been published yet.

items.title: VRCycle: A Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating a Virtual Reality Cycling Intervention in People With Knee Osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A two-arm feasibility RCT with 41 knee osteoarthritis participants found that VR-enhanced cycling was highly feasible and acceptable, with 91% adherence and 90% retention. Both VR-enhanced and traditional cycling showed within-group improvements in pain, function, and exercise capacity, supporting progression to a full efficacy trial.
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性 RCT 表明，VR 辅助骑行对膝骨关节炎患者可行且可接受，初步疗效与传统骑行相似。这支持了将 VR 融入膝 OA 康复方案的进一步研究。
items.titleZh: VRCycle：一项评估虚拟现实骑行干预对膝骨关节炎患者可行性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名膝骨关节炎患者进行的双臂可行性随机对照试验发现，VR 辅助骑行具有高度可行性和可接受性，依从性达 91%，留存率达 90%。VR 辅助骑行和传统骑行均在组内疼痛、功能和运动能力方面显示改善，支持进一步开展全面疗效试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility RCT suggests that VR-enhanced cycling is feasible and acceptable for knee osteoarthritis patients, with preliminary efficacy similar to traditional cycling. This supports further research into integrating VR into knee OA rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项可行性研究，样本量小，未设功效以评估疗效，因此不能得出确切的治疗效果结论。
items.limitationEn: As a feasibility study with a small sample size, it was not powered to evaluate efficacy, thus definitive conclusions on treatment effects cannot be drawn.

items.title: Effects of adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy on postural responses and autonomic function in individuals with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT with 30 MS patients found that adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy reduced response latency in specific postural tests (Adaptation Test toes-down: p = .034; Motor Control Test back-small: p = .006), but showed no significant between-group differences at any time point or for autonomic function.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 提示，颅骶疗法（CST）作为多发性硬化症传统理疗的辅助手段，可能对特定姿势反应参数产生影响。但在更大的患者群体中，其对姿势控制和自主神经功能的明确优越性仍需更多研究验证。
items.titleZh: 颅骶疗法作为辅助手段对多发性硬化症患者姿势反应和自主神经功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名多发性硬化症患者进行的单盲随机对照试验发现，颅骶疗法作为传统理疗的辅助手段，在特定姿势测试（适应性测试脚趾朝下：p = .034；运动控制测试背部小肌：p = .006）中缩短了反应潜伏期，但任何时间点或自主神经功能方面均未显示显著组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that craniosacral therapy (CST) as an adjunct to conventional physiotherapy in MS might influence specific postural response parameters. However, its definitive superiority for postural control and autonomic function in a larger patient population requires further validation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（30 人），且未显示颅骶疗法对自主神经功能的显著治疗效果，限制了结论的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (30 participants) and lack of significant treatment effect on autonomic function for craniosacral therapy limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Physical calibration and signal periodic updates to synchronize IMUs for 5-day continuous knee flexion tracking
items.summary: A study with 15 volunteers demonstrated that combining physical calibration with signal-based periodic updates effectively synchronized wearable IMUs for 5-day continuous knee flexion tracking, achieving high correlation (r ≥ 0.971) and low RMSD (≤ 6.2 degrees) compared to motion capture, enabling accurate real-world kinematic monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 对膝关节屈曲的长期、连续性运动学追踪，这项方法在真实世界中有可能实现。这项小样本研究提示，你也许能通过物理校准与信号更新结合的方式，让可穿戴 IMU 系统达到长达 5 天的精确度，相关性 (r ≥ 0.971) 和 RMSD (≤ 6.2 度) 都表现不错。
items.titleZh: 用于 5 天连续膝关节屈曲跟踪的 IMU 物理校准和信号周期性更新同步方法
items.summaryZh: 一项涉及 15 名志愿者的研究表明，将物理校准与基于信号的周期性更新相结合，可有效同步可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU），实现长达 5 天的膝关节屈曲连续跟踪。与运动捕捉相比，该方法实现了高相关性（r ≥ 0.971）和低均方根差（RMSD ≤ 6.2 度），从而实现准确的真实世界运动学监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Long-term, continuous kinematic tracking of knee flexion might be achievable in real-world settings with this method. This small-sample study suggests you could achieve accurate 5-day tracking with wearable IMU systems by combining physical calibration with signal updates, showing good correlation (r ≥ 0.971) and low RMSD (≤ 6.2 degrees).
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康志愿者，在临床患者人群中，长期穿戴 IMU 的依从性和同步精度可能需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on healthy volunteers; adherence to long-term IMU wear and synchronization accuracy in clinical patient populations may require further validation.

items.title: Cellular health beyond body composition: phase angle suitability for breast cancer patients undergoing physical training: a randomised trial
items.summary: A randomized trial with 37 breast cancer patients found no significant between-group differences in phase angle (PhA) or body composition between home-based and hospital-supervised high-intensity training. Changes in PhA (p < 0.0001), BMI (p = 0.0377), fat mass (p = 0.0387), and muscle mass (p = 0.0449) were primarily treatment-dependent, supporting structured home-based exercise and PhA as an independent cellular health marker.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对乳腺癌患者而言，无论是居家运动还是医院监督下的高强度训练，身体成分和血参数的变化主要取决于化疗而非运动模式。这意味着你可以更灵活地为乳腺癌患者开具运动处方，同时相位角（PhA）可作为细胞和代谢状态的独立指标。
items.titleZh: 身体成分之外的细胞健康：相位角在接受体育训练的乳腺癌患者中的适用性：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 37 名乳腺癌患者进行的随机试验发现，居家运动组和医院监督下高强度训练组在相位角（PhA）或身体成分方面没有显著组间差异。相位角（p < 0.0001）、BMI（p = 0.0377）、脂肪量（p = 0.0387）和肌肉量（p = 0.0449）的变化主要与治疗相关，支持结构化居家运动和将 PhA 作为独立的细胞健康标志物。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that for breast cancer patients, changes in body composition and blood parameters are primarily chemotherapy-dependent, not exercise modality-dependent, for both home-based and supervised high-intensity training. This implies greater flexibility in prescribing exercise for breast cancer patients, with phase angle (PhA) serving as an independent indicator of cellular and metabolic status.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（37 人），且居家组和医院组在训练监督强度和环境上存在差异，可能影响结果的可比性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (37 participants), and differences in supervision intensity and environment between home-based and hospital-based groups may affect comparability of results.

items.title: Increasing Efficiency in Resistance Training? Exploring a Minimalistic Approach in Supramaximal Accentuated Eccentric Loading: A Narrative Review
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes evidence on supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading (SAEL), indicating its potential to promote strength gains with low volumes (e.g., 2–4 sets of 3–8 repetitions per week) due to high eccentric mechanical stimulus. However, direct comparisons with traditional resistance training are sparse, and evidence on physiological adaptations primarily comes from eccentric-only training.
items.curatedReason: 超最大离心负荷 (SAEL) 训练在提高力量方面可能有效，即便训练容量很低（每周 2-4 组，每组 3-8 次）。如果你在寻找一种高机械刺激、低训练量的方案，这可能值得尝试。但请注意，目前与传统阻力训练的直接比较研究还很有限。
items.titleZh: 提高阻力训练效率？探索超最大离心负荷中的极简主义方法：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 本叙述性综述综合了超最大离心负荷（SAEL）的证据，表明其通过高离心机械刺激，有望以低训练量（例如，每周 2-4 组，每组 3-8 次）促进力量增长。然而，与传统阻力训练的直接比较稀少，且生理适应性证据主要来自纯离心训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: Supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading (SAEL) training may be effective for strength gains, even with low volumes (e.g., 2–4 sets of 3–8 repetitions per week). If you're looking for a high mechanical stimulus with low training volume, this might be worth exploring. However, direct comparisons with traditional resistance training are still sparse.
items.limitation: 该综述是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且大部分证据来自高强度离心训练而非 SAEL 干预本身，缺乏与传统阻力训练的直接比较。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias, and much of the evidence is derived from high-intensity eccentric-only training rather than SAEL interventions, lacking direct comparisons with traditional resistance training.
